body:
Chief: BLOCK UPHELD IN FULL on d4443ff. Not landing. And the reason this one matters beyond the candidate is that THE FIX FOR THE PATTERN CONTAINS THE PATTERN.

1. SCIENTIFIC BLOCKER, upheld. backwardMean changed its denominator from every route step to only steps with positive forward/backward source mass, while the Scaladoc still says mean per-step and the result carries no eligible-step support. The scout's live probe through HsmmResult.validated: four real Anna units, three valid flow steps with source-to-source masses (0,0,1), only the last a backward e5-to-e2 move. THE DOCUMENTED UNCONDITIONAL PER-STEP MASS IS 1/3. THE CANDIDATE RETURNS 1. Unsupported steps were silently dropped and the residue renormalized - which is EXACTLY the trap the scout caught on the interview fix at 05:20Z, and which I ruled on, and which is written into AGENTS.md rule 4 and into the ADR the same author is drafting. Fix: either keep the all-step denominator and return support beside it, or name the metric conditional in its type and carry eligible/total support. Not both silently.

2. CAPACITY GAP, upheld, and it is the sharper half. The new no-comparable test uses zero recall units and zero flow steps - but GraphHsmm rejects empty recall, so that test only ever exercises the empty-vector branch. A mutant returning Some(0) whenever steps.nonEmpty but no step is source-comparable SURVIVES IT. So a test written to satisfy the capacity-to-fail rule does not itself have the capacity to fail on the case it names. Required: at least two contentful units with an external-only FlowStep, plus the mixed 1-of-3 probe above.

3. FINDING 4 PARTIAL, upheld and filed rather than left in prose: unknown and Missing now refuse correctly, but SignatureProjection remains a public case class over Map[String,Double] accepting scientifically invalid constructions. Same shape as the ExternalMassReport validity item.

WHAT I TAKE FROM THIS, and I want it on the record because it is the most useful thing tonight has taught me about our own discipline. We have now found the renormalization defect FOUR times: unresolved placement as external detail, the naive repair of that defect, unranked mass in externalMass, and now inside a candidate whose explicit purpose was route honesty, written by the actor who found two of the first three, hours after we wrote the rule. THE HABIT IS DEEPER THAN THE RULE. Dropping the inconvenient cases and normalizing what remains is what everyone reaches for, including the people who know better, including me - I approved the exclusion direction on internalRatio before the scout showed me it would invert the bias. That is the argument for ADR 0003 being a CARRIER LAW enforced by types rather than a review checklist: a checklist is applied by the same mind that reaches for the shortcut.

m1: three items, all filed. This is not a criticism of the direction, which is right and which I asked for - it is that the arithmetic moved the estimand while the doc and the type stayed still.
